name: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
headline: Ship faster on infrastructure you can trust.
intro: Automated pipelines, resilient cloud environments and clear observability, so releases are routine, systems stay available and costs stay under control.

overview.what: DevOps and cloud infrastructure brings development and operations together: cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, containers, monitoring, security and cost management.
overview.why: Software only creates value once it is running reliably for users. Manual deployments, fragile servers and missing visibility slow teams down and turn every release into a risk.
problems: Manual, error-prone deployments that happen late at night and break things
Servers configured by hand that nobody can safely reproduce
Outages discovered by customers before the team notices
Cloud bills that grow without clear ownership or limits
overview.approach: We codify the environment, automate the path from commit to production, add monitoring and alerting before it is needed, and review security and spend as continuous practices rather than one-off checks.

deliver.d: Network, compute, storage and database design on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud matched to your workload.
Automated build, test and deployment flows with approvals and safe rollbacks.
Version-controlled environments that can be recreated or scaled in minutes.
Docker and Kubernetes setups for portable, scalable services.
Dashboards, logs, traces and alerts that show problems before users feel them.
Planned moves to the cloud and ongoing right-sizing of resources.

capabilities.d: Blue-green and rolling strategies keep services available while new versions go live.
Capacity follows demand so peaks are handled and quiet periods cost less.
Tested backups, multi-zone design and recovery objectives agreed with the business.
Least-privilege access, secrets management, network isolation, patching and audit logging.
Consistent development, staging and production environments built from the same definitions.
Tagging, budgets and reports that show what each service costs.

process.d: We review current infrastructure, release practice, incidents, security posture and spend.
A cloud and delivery blueprint is agreed with clear priorities and trade-offs.
Accounts, networks, identity and base infrastructure are created as code.
Build, test, security scan and deploy steps are automated for each service.
Workloads move in planned stages with rehearsed rollback.
Monitoring, on-call practice, patching and regular cost and performance reviews.

benefits.d: Automation makes shipping small changes routine instead of stressful.
Redundancy and monitoring reduce downtime and shorten recovery.
Right-sizing and budgets keep spend aligned with value.
Consistent controls reduce exposure and simplify audits.
Reliable environments let engineers focus on product work.

usecases.d: A growing application migrates to a scalable, monitored cloud setup.
Shared CI/CD standards speed up delivery across several products.
Retail and booking platforms scale automatically for campaigns and events.
Unused and oversized resources are identified and trimmed.

cta.h: Make releases boring and uptime dependable.
cta.p: Tell us how you deploy and host today. We will review it and propose the changes that matter most.
